tspan.tspan: A dollar that cost ₹8 in 1973 costs ₹94.94 today
Rupees per US dollar at each month’s end, 1973 to October 2026, on a log scale: the same slope
means the same percentage fall. The rupee fell fastest from 1985 to 1995, by 11.3% a year.
Source: Federal Reserve Board (H.10) via FRED; Zerodha calculations
